claim: Patchline ships a capability-scoped sandbox for the agent with a proven no-side-effect-outside-scope property. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the no-side-effect-outside-scope claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make capability-scoped-sandbox-gate`.
